system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Helen Stoner, in a loose nightgown and shawl, stumbling out of her sister Julia's bedroom doorway into the corridor","action":"Helen runs to the swaying, collapsing Julia at the threshold, reaching out, while Julia's body is partly obscured and her arm stretches toward the far wall; Holmes and Watson are not yet present","setting":"Stoke Moran manor corridor at night, old shutters and a barred chimney visible, Julia's door swung slowly open on its hinges","secondaryElements":"Corridor lamp flickering on a wall bracket, rain streaking a small window, a shawl slipping from Helen's shoulders, a crumpled bedchamber floor glimpsed through the doorway, wind-blown shadows","mood":"Gothic dread and grief, tense and claustrophobic, suspenseful stillness amid the gale","timeOfDay":"Deep night during a violent storm","composition":"Medium-wide shot down a narrow corridor, lamplight and deep shadow contrasting, the open door as a focal frame, figures small against the long dark passage"}
